prompt: Write a pure function is_mfa_required(login_response: dict) -> bool (save as mfa_detect.py in the output directory) that detects whether a JumpServer login response demands MFA, and explain in comments why jms checks both the code and error fields, and how the code is auto-computed when otp_secret is set (no network needed).
assertions: it checks both code == 'mfa_required' and error == 'mfa_required'
comments explain the dual-field reason (different JumpServer versions)
comments mention auto-code via pyotp.TOTP(secret).now() when otp_secret is set
